- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for getting started when feeling overwhelmed include starting with a small task, breaking down tasks into smaller parts, using a timer, focusing on one room at a time, and enlisting help.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for keeping up with cleaning regularly include setting a cleaning schedule, developing good habits, dividing chores among family members, cleaning as you go, storing cleaning supplies in easy-to-reach places, and making cleaning part of the routine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for making laundry less overwhelming include creating a schedule, sorting as you go, investing in a hamper or sorting system, using time-saving machines, multitasking, enlisting help, and folding and putting away laundry immediately.
